segments.text: Instruct the children of Israel, and say to them, My oblation, the bread of the order of My table. That which you offer upon the altar. Is there not a fire that will consume it? To be received from you before Me for a pleasant smell. Sons of Israel, My people, be admonished to offer it before Me in its season.
From the vessels of the house of holiness, it shall be poured out a libation of choice wine unto the Name of the Lord.
